## Referenced footnotes

```````````````````````````````` example
> - [^a]: first
>
>       Term
>
>       : body
>
> outside
.
Document scope=1:1..7:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Callout scope=1:1..7:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=2
│   ├── List scope=1:3..6:1 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   │   └── ListItem scope=1:3..6:1 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=0
│   └── Paragraph scope=7:3..7:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=7:3..7:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="outside" children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:5..6:1 id="a" children=2
    ├── Paragraph scope=1:11..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:11..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="first" children=0
    └── DefinitionList scope=3:9..5:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Definition scope=3:9..5:14 anchor=null attributes={} compact=false children=1
            ├── DefinitionTerm children=1
            │   └── Text scope=3:9..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Term" children=0
            └── DefinitionBody children=1
                └── Paragraph scope=5:11..5:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
                    └── Text scope=5:11..5:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Every example of the [footnotes module](../../../../docs/specs/dialect/footnotes.md)
is retained byte for byte, followed by the O4 conformance boundaries. Referenced
and inline forms share the same citation and document footnote model.

A defined call is a one-item `Cite` whose `Citation` names the footnote by its normalized id with empty affixes, and every definition is a `Footnote` under `Document` after the content:

```````````````````````````````` example
Text[^1] and more[^note].

[^1]: The first note.
[^note]: The second note.
.
Document scope=1:1..4:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Text" children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:5..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:6..1:7 referent=footnote(id="1") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:9..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" and more" children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:18..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:19..1:23 referent=footnote(id="note") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:25..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="." children=0
├── Footnote scope=3:1..3:21 id="1" children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=3:7..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="The first note." children=0
└── Footnote scope=4:1..4:25 id="note" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=4:10..4:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=4:10..4:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="The second note." children=0
````````````````````````````````

Repeated calls share one `Footnote`; the body is never duplicated:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^a] [^a]

[^a]: once
.
Document scope=1:1..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Cite scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:2..1:3 referent=footnote(id="a") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:5..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:6..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:7..1:8 referent=footnote(id="a") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..3:10 id="a" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=3:7..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="once" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Continuation lines are indented at least four columns, and the content is block content parsed by the ordinary block parser:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^a]

[^a]: first paragraph
    continued

    second paragraph
.
Document scope=1:1..6:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Cite scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:2..1:3 referent=footnote(id="a") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..6:20 id="a" children=2
    ├── Paragraph scope=3:7..4:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    │   ├── Text scope=3:7..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="first paragraph" children=0
    │   ├── SoftBreak scope=3:22..3:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    │   └── Text scope=4:5..4:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="continued" children=0
    └── Paragraph scope=6:5..6:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=6:5..6:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="second paragraph" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A valid definition that no call references is still a `Footnote`:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^a]: kept

text
.
Document scope=1:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=3:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:1..2:0 id="a" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=1:7..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:7..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="kept" children=0
````````````````````````````````

When two definitions share a key the first in source order wins and every call resolves to it; a later one is still parsed as a definition, as cmark-gfm's block grammar parses it, and remains a `Footnote` after the winner with the same id:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^a]

[^a]: first

[^a]: second
.
Document scope=1:1..5:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Cite scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:2..1:3 referent=footnote(id="a") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=3:1..4:0 id="a" children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=3:7..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="first" children=0
└── Footnote scope=5:1..5:12 id="a" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=5:7..5:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=5:7..5:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="second" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A call whose label no definition defines is not a call, and only a literal source caret opens a call:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^x] and [\^a] and [&#94;a]

[^a]: note
.
Document scope=1:1..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[^x] and [^a] and [^a]" children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..3:10 id="a" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=3:7..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="note" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The key is case-folded, so a call and a definition that differ in case share one footnote, whose id is the normalized form:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^Note]

[^note]: x
.
Document scope=1:1..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Cite scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:2..1:6 referent=footnote(id="note") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..3:10 id="note" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=3:10..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=3:10..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Direct and resolving reference tails, then spans, are tested before a footnote call:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^a](u) [^a]{.x}

[^a]: note
.
Document scope=1:1..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Link scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("u") title=null children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="^a" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:8..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Span scope=1:9..1:16 anchor=null attributes={.x} children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:10..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="^a" children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..3:10 id="a" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=3:7..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="note" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A call inside a footnote's own content is an id edge, and a `[^label]:` line is never a link reference definition:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^a]

[^a]: see [^b]
[^b]: end
.
Document scope=1:1..4:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Cite scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:2..1:3 referent=footnote(id="a") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=3:1..3:14 id="a" children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│       ├── Text scope=3:7..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="see " children=0
│       └── Cite scope=3:11..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Citation scope=3:12..3:13 referent=footnote(id="b") children=0
│               ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│               └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=4:1..4:9 id="b" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=4:7..4:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=4:7..4:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="end" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Inline footnotes



An unescaped `^` immediately followed by `[` pushes an inline-footnote opener onto the shared
bracket stack at inline step A7. Every recognized inline footnote creates one
`Footnote` whose content is the parsed inline body and one one-item `Cite`
with referent `footnote(id)` and empty affixes:

```````````````````````````````` example
text^[an inline note]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:5..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:7..1:20 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:5..1:21 id="inline-1" children=1
    └── Text scope=1:7..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="an inline note" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
^[a *b*]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Cite scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:3..1:7 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:1..1:8 id="inline-1" children=2
    ├── Text scope=1:3..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
    └── Emphasis scope=1:5..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:6..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The `]` that matches the opener closes the footnote without attempting any
link, reference, span, cite, or attribute tail, so `^[a](b)` is a `Cite`
followed by text `(b)`. At one `^`, the inline footnote wins over a `[^label]`
call and over superscript, so `^[^1]` is a footnote whose body is text `^1`:

```````````````````````````````` example
^[a](b) ^[^1]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Cite scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:3..1:3 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:5..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="(b) " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:9..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:11..1:12 referent=footnote(id="inline-2") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:1..1:4 id="inline-1" children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:9..1:13 id="inline-2" children=1
    └── Text scope=1:11..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="^1" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Inside the body, a link opener is closed by its own `]` and tail, and a
footnote opener inside a link label is closed by the first `]`. Ids are
assigned once, during document finalization, after every authored id is
known. Let `A` be the ids of every `Footnote` produced from a winning or
unreferenced definition. Inline footnotes are numbered in ascending order of
the start position of their `^[`, an outer footnote before one nested in its
body; the `N`-th receives `inline-N` when that string is not in `A` and not
already assigned, otherwise `inline-N-K` for the smallest `K` of at least 1
in neither set. The value carries no authored meaning; consumers compare and
copy ids and never display them:

```````````````````````````````` example
^[a ^[b] c]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Cite scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:3..1:10 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:1..1:11 id="inline-1" children=3
│   ├── Text scope=1:3..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:5..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:7..1:7 referent=footnote(id="inline-2") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:9..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" c" children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:5..1:8 id="inline-2" children=1
    └── Text scope=1:7..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[^inline-1] ^[b]

[^inline-1]: authored
.
Document scope=1:1..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Cite scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:2..1:10 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:12..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:13..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:15..1:15 referent=footnote(id="inline-1-1") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:13..1:16 id="inline-1-1" children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:15..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..3:21 id="inline-1" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=3:14..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=3:14..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="authored" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A body that is empty or consists only of spaces and tabs is invalid; the
opener is text. `\^[` never opens:

```````````````````````````````` example
^[] ^[ ] \^[a]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="^[] ^[ ] ^[a]" children=0
````````````````````````````````


Escaped brackets and literal caret spellings:

```````````````````````````````` example
^[a \] b \[ c] \^[x] \\^[y] &#94;[z]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:36 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:36 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
│   ├── Cite scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:3..1:13 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:15..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" ^[x] \\" children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:24..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:26..1:26 referent=footnote(id="inline-2") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:28..1:36 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" ^[z]" children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:1..1:14 id="inline-1" children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:3..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a ] b [ c" children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:24..1:27 id="inline-2" children=1
    └── Text scope=1:26..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} literal="y" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Empty, tab-only, unmatched and nested failed candidates:

```````````````````````````````` example
^[] ^[ 	 ] ^[open *em*

^[a [b] c] ^[a ^[] b]
.
Document scope=1:1..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal="^[] ^[ \t ] ^[open " children=0
│   └── Emphasis scope=1:19..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:20..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="em" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Cite scope=3:1..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=3:3..3:9 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=3:11..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=3:12..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=3:14..3:20 referent=footnote(id="inline-2") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=3:1..3:10 id="inline-1" children=1
│   └── Text scope=3:3..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a [b] c" children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:12..3:21 id="inline-2" children=1
    └── Text scope=3:14..3:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a ^[] b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Unresolved calls do not allocate ids; generated ids do not define calls:

```````````````````````````````` example
[^missing] [^inline-1] ^[first [^missing]] ^[second]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:52 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:52 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[^missing] [^inline-1] " children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:24..1:42 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:26..1:41 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:43..1:43 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:44..1:52 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:46..1:51 referent=footnote(id="inline-2") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:24..1:42 id="inline-1" children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:26..1:41 anchor=null attributes={} literal="first [^missing]" children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:44..1:52 id="inline-2" children=1
    └── Text scope=1:46..1:51 anchor=null attributes={} literal="second" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Normalized authored ids reserve all suffixes, including duplicates:

```````````````````````````````` example
^[a] ^[b]

[^INLINE-1]: one
[^inline-1-1]: suffix one
[^inline-1-3]: suffix three
[^inline-2]: two
[^inline-1]: duplicate
.
Document scope=1:1..7:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Cite scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:3..1:3 referent=footnote(id="inline-1-2") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:5..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:6..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:8..1:8 referent=footnote(id="inline-2-1") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0

│               └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:4..1:11 id="inline-1" children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:6..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="first" children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:14..1:22 id="inline-2" children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:16..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="second" children=0
├── Footnote scope=3:9..3:16 id="inline-3" children=1
│   └── Text scope=3:11..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="third" children=0
└── Footnote scope=4:1..4:9 id="inline-4" children=1
    └── Text scope=4:3..4:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="fourth" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Nested note survives an unmatched outer opener:

```````````````````````````````` example
^[unclosed ^[closed]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="^[unclosed " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:12..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:14..1:19 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:12..1:20 id="inline-1" children=1
    └── Text scope=1:14..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="closed" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Whitespace and decoded empty-looking content:

```````````````````````````````` example
^[
] ^[&#32;] ^[\ ]
.
Document scope=1:1..2:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
│   ├── Cite scope=1:1..2:1 anchor=null attributes={} children=1

│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=2:2..2:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=2:3..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=2:5..2:9 referent=footnote(id="inline-2") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=2:11..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=2:12..2:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=2:14..2:15 referent=footnote(id="inline-3") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:1..2:1 id="inline-1" children=1
│   └── SoftBreak scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
├── Footnote scope=2:3..2:10 id="inline-2" children=1
│   └── Text scope=2:5..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
└── Footnote scope=2:12..2:16 id="inline-3" children=1
    └── Text scope=2:14..2:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="\\ " children=0
````````````````````````````````

Inline opener owns the bracket before a wikilink:

```````````````````````````````` example
^[[[note]]] ^[[x]]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Cite scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:3..1:10 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:12..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:13..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:15..1:17 referent=footnote(id="inline-2") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:1..1:11 id="inline-1" children=1
│   └── CrossLink scope=1:3..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} dest=cross(path="note",anchor=null) label=null children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:13..1:18 id="inline-2" children=1
    └── Text scope=1:15..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[x]" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Bare URL forms respect the inline-footnote body boundary:

```````````````````````````````` example
^[see http://example.com] ^[https://example.com/a?q=1] ^[ftp://example.com/a] ^[www.example.com/a]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:98 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:98 anchor=null attributes={} children=7
│   ├── Cite scope=1:1..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:3..1:24 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:26..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:27..1:54 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:29..1:53 referent=footnote(id="inline-2") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:55..1:55 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:56..1:77 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:58..1:76 referent=footnote(id="inline-3") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:78..1:78 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:79..1:98 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:81..1:97 referent=footnote(id="inline-4") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:1..1:25 id="inline-1" children=2
│   ├── Text scope=1:3..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="see " children=0
│   └── Link scope=1:7..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("http://example.com") title=null children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:7..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} literal="http://example.com" children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:27..1:54 id="inline-2" children=1

│       └── Text scope=1:29..1:53 anchor=null attributes={} literal="https://example.com/a?q=1" children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:56..1:77 id="inline-3" children=1
│   └── Link scope=1:58..1:76 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("ftp://example.com/a") title=null children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:58..1:76 anchor=null attributes={} literal="ftp://example.com/a" children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:79..1:98 id="inline-4" children=1
    └── Link scope=1:81..1:97 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("http://www.example.com/a") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=1:81..1:97 anchor=null attributes={} literal="www.example.com/a" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Escaped closers stay in the URL; ordinary URL punctuation remains unchanged:

```````````````````````````````` example
^[http://example.com/a\]b] http://example.com/a] ^[http://example.com/a\\] tail
.
Document scope=1:1..1:79 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:79 anchor=null attributes={} children=6
│   ├── Cite scope=1:1..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:3..1:25 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:27..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Link scope=1:28..1:48 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("http://example.com/a]") title=null children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=1:28..1:48 anchor=null attributes={} literal="http://example.com/a]" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:49..1:49 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:50..1:74 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:52..1:73 referent=footnote(id="inline-2") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:75..1:79 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" tail" children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:1..1:26 id="inline-1" children=1
│   └── Link scope=1:3..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("http://example.com/a\\]b") title=null children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:3..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="http://example.com/a\\]b" children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:50..1:74 id="inline-2" children=1
    └── Link scope=1:52..1:73 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("http://example.com/a\\\\") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=1:52..1:73 anchor=null attributes={} literal="http://example.com/a\\\\" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Footnote bodies in nested notes and deferred directive labels allow bare URLs:

```````````````````````````````` example

│                   ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│                   └── CitationSuffix children=0

        └── Text scope=1:44..1:58 anchor=null attributes={} literal="www.example.com" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Caret pairs end exactly where a footnote opener starts:

```````````````````````````````` example
^^^^text^^word^^^[note]^^end^
.
Document scope=1:1..1:29 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:29 anchor=null attributes={} children=9
│   ├── Superscript scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   ├── Superscript scope=1:3..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:5..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
│   ├── Superscript scope=1:9..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:11..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="word" children=0
│   ├── Superscript scope=1:15..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:17..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:19..1:22 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Superscript scope=1:24..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:26..1:29 anchor=null attributes={} literal="end^" children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:17..1:23 id="inline-1" children=1
    └── Text scope=1:19..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal="note" children=0
````````````````````````````````
